summary: @servicetitan/react-hooks preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on install
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself string-array obfuscated and downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes a sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte obfuscated Bun bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, shuffled numeric string-array with a rotate function, hex-numbered identifiers) whose contents are not human-readable. `math_init.js` is not listed in `package.json` `files` (which declares only `dist` and `src`), so the executed payload is not part of the declared file manifest for a React hooks library. Running an obfuscated 727 KB blob under a second language runtime specifically avoids Node-based install-time inspection. A React hooks library has no legitimate need to download and execute a separate runtime plus an obfuscated bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
